edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender argument for the internal balance move in ERC20.transfer.
msg.sender indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender] and is compared with _from in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written by approve.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the delegatecall in delegate().
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the privileged list() function.
tx.origin is used to assign owner and to grant infinite allowance during construction.
tx.origin directly flows into the owner state variable and allowance mapping.
block.timestamp + 600 builds the swap deadline inside list().
The router deadline argument is derived from block.timestamp.
The checkBots modifier performs an external low-level call to botProtection before the guarded body executes state changes.
delegate() executes arbitrary calldata at an attacker-supplied address in the token's storage context.
list() makes an external call to botProtection with a user-supplied array before the balance distribution loop.
list() calls the Uniswap router addLiquidityETH while holding ETH and before the distribution loop.
_value is subtracted from allowance[_from][msg.sender] with unchecked arithmetic under Solidity ^0.7.0.
The constructor performs the tx.origin based owner and allowance assignment.
botProtection state variable provides the target address for the modifier's external call.
uniPair is passed as the pair argument into the botProtection low-level call.
allowance mapping is read and decremented in transferFrom.
balanceOf mapping is read and written in transferFrom.
uniRouter state variable is the target of the addLiquidityETH call in list().
wrappedEther is used together with address(this) to compute the pair in the constructor.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom.
checkBots modifier is applied to transferFrom.
transferFrom mutates the allowance mapping.
transferFrom mutates the balanceOf mapping of sender and recipient.
